_comment: TEMPLATE for the synthetic W6+SH arm (docs/SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network.md §11).
The station block is filled in by scripts/simnet_make_producer_config.py from the
fixture manifest — never hand-edit it, or the HELD coordinates can drift from the
fixture and nothing downstream can notice (a held coordinate is not estimated).
WHAT THIS ARM IS FOR.  Every §9 arm to date runs the INT posture, where the
satellite code bias is REMOVED from the observables by the same .BIA the sim
injected: no B records exist, so the code-bias channel is untestable, and the
clock <-> code-bias <-> ionosphere states whose common exchanges the §9.9
campaign cornered as the source of the field's 1.3 m wire wander DO NOT EXIST
in that posture (sim-internal wander there is 0.024 m).  This arm runs the
field's wander-bearing posture on synthetic truth so the wander decomposes
against a known answer.
THE ARMING IS ONE KNOB, AND IT IS DELIBERATELY THE COUPLED ONE.
network.estimate_iono_sh = true forces the WHOLE coherent slice at
GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:2060-2107 — estimate_sat_code_bias, estimate_sat_biases,
promote_sat_code_bias, estimate_ifb (receiver DCB), ionosphere_weighting.enable,
and enable_code_phase_bias = OFF.  §11 item 2: arm the FULL slice, never a
partial one.  Do NOT also set network.estimate_sat_code_bias by hand — it is
implied, and writing both invites one of them being edited alone later.
NO GIM IS LOADED ON THIS PATH, and that retires §11 item 3's concern.  The
external GIM and the co-estimated SH field are mutually exclusive iono
constraints (ApplicationNetworkSetup.cpp:386-440: under estimateNetworkIonoSh
the SH model is built and the IONEX is explicitly NOT read).  So there is no
real-DOY-129-GIM-vs-synthetic-truth mismatch to design around: the constraint
is the estimated field itself, plus a climatology Kaula prior.  What IS
load-bearing from the ionosphere_weighting block is the ELEVATION CUTOFF, which
gates which lines of sight get an SH tie row at all.
elevation_cutoff_deg = 25 here.  It defaults to TEN
(GnssConfigLoad.cpp:1414-1416), and a default-cutoff run is exactly the
'SH-VTEC / W6 slice: PARTIAL 2/3' posture whose 50-station attempt withheld all
240 epochs.  The 25 deg cutoff is the one validated SH lever (a00 296 -> -305
TECU at 10 deg vs 30.9 -> 29.4 TECU at 25 deg, 305 sta).  The FIELD lineage
currently runs 15 by user directive, so the 15-vs-25 A/B is a sibling arm
(§11 item 4) — one key, own product path.
SH DEGREE 15 matches the in-flight 305-station field arm and is the sanctioned
pairing at >= 150 stations WITH the 25 deg cutoff (GnssConfigNetworkPosture.cpp:364).
At 50 stations that pairing is NOT sanctioned — the validated low-n lineage is
degree 4 — so a small-n rung of the minimum-n ladder must override the degree
and say so.
CLOCK DATUM STATION is chosen NEAR THE EQUATOR on purpose.  §9.8 measured that
the common level FOLLOWS the datum station and that a polar datum wanders ~8x
an equatorial one; the 50-station G-A template's S01000SIM sits at lat -68.75.
Grading a wander channel from a polar datum would amplify the very quantity
this arm exists to decompose.  The field's own datum (MBAR00UGA) is equatorial.
If the generator has to fall back (datum name not in the roster) it picks
stations[0], which for a Fibonacci roster is the MOST polar station — check the
resolved value, do not assume it.
FREQUENCY / CHANNEL MODE.  'all'/'all' is kept from the 50-station template
rather than the field's 'dual'/'single'.  On this fixture they are the SAME
SET: the sim writes exactly C1C/L1C/C2W/L2W for GPS (src/sim/main.cpp:1963),
one channel per band, so 'all' admits precisely what 'dual'+'single' would
select.  Stated because it looks like a posture difference and is not.
Fingerprinted toggles (phase_leveling, emit_ura, code_bias_disc_jump_test,
mw_detect) are legal here because this is a FRESH convergence — there is no
stored snapshot to invalidate.  cycle_slip.if_phase_td closes the standing
invariant #1 bundle that the 50-station arm ran PARTIAL 1/2, and
cycle_slip.datum_station_detect closes the datum-station slip blind spot
(§9.7.10: C rms 3.4x better, CLK_STEP marks 12 -> 1, at zero withhold cost).
trace_estimability is ON because the expected failure mode of this arm is a
rank-gate withhold, and 'withheld every epoch' with no spectrum dump is an
unfalsifiable result (§0 error class: an instrument that does not record the
thing looked for).  network_estimability.csv is the dump that names the
near-null directions by family.
trace_sat_bias_states + trace_rx_states are the §4.8 export gap: there is NO
formal sigma on the B record in any configuration, so the code-bias variance
factor — the field cb-vf ~ 10 question this whole arm exists to answer — is
structurally unobtainable from the product.  Both are trace-only, default-OFF,
no product grammar change.

estimation.//iono: The cutoff, NOT the enable, is the load-bearing field here — the
estimation.//iono2: enable is forced on by the W6 slice anyway.  Values other than the
estimation.//iono3: cutoff are the shipped defaults, restated so an arm cannot inherit a
estimation.//sh: Field-matched SH posture (_cbq305_2f_12h_d10): degree 15, single shell,
estimation.//sh2: sun-fixed, representation-error demean + d5-keep.  trace: true is what
estimation.//sh3: opens network_vtec_sh.csv (coefficients + sigma) and the per-epoch
estimation.//sh4: network_vtec_sh_health.csv (a00 + a00 sigma + per-degree rms) — the a00
estimation.//sh5: channel of the §11 item 4 decomposition.  network_ionosphere.csv is NOT
estimation.//sh6: a substitute: it writes x_r alone and is frame-broken (CLAUDE.md).

network.//datum: Equatorial by choice (§9.8) — see the header.  Overridden by the
network.//datum2: generator ONLY if this name is absent from the fixture roster.
network.//w6: === The W6 + SH-VTEC slice: ONE knob, coupled set forced by the loader ===
network.//qc2: === Fingerprinted — legal only on a FRESH convergence, which this is ===
network.//mark: === Event MARKING (an unarmed marker reads as no event) ===
network.//par: parallel_carry and parallel_reduce are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE — the loader
network.//par2: silently forces parallel_carry OFF if both are set.
network.//lane: Lane layer OFF — measured a net loss at BOTH 63 and 305 stations once
network.//lane2: the window is settled (AGU-26 campaign amendment 1).
